'''mwod Tosche Station revivial act 4''' is a [[Light]] constructed list published on [[Game Players Network]].

== Deck info ==
* '''Player:''' [[mwod]]
* '''Published:''' 8 January 2005 (Game Players Network)
* '''GPN category:''' Standard
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Original VS8]]
* '''Side:''' [[Light]]
* '''Starting Card:''' —
* '''Starting Interrupt:''' {{CardLink|Careful Planning (V) (Virtual Set 8)|VS8O-05-Careful_Planning.png|label=Careful Planning (V)}}
* '''Starting Effect:''' {{CardLink|Your Insight Serves You Well|DS2-L-yourinsightservesyouwell.gif}}
* '''Strategy:''' Tosche Station revivial act 4
* '''GEMP Importable deck:''' [[Media:POVS8 TSRA4 mwod LS 2005 GPN.txt|Download]] (omits Careful Planning (V), Sai'torr Kal Fas (V): no GEMP blueprint)

== Notes ==

* Qty 59 as published: starting:6 header but 7 lines, with 'careful planning(v)' listed twice (dested x2 as posted); Characters:23 header but 24 listed; Ships:4 header but 3 listed; Interrupts 13 as listed.
* No objective; starting interrupt Careful Planning (V) (Virtual Set 8) with Tatooine, Tosche Station and City Outskirts; starting effect Your Insight Serves You Well.
* Posted 'Obi-Wan's Hutt' dested Tatooine: Obi-Wan's Hut; 'Tantive 4' the printed Tantive IV; 'Jar Jar' Jar Jar Binks; 'Qui-Gon Jinn's Lightsaber' Qui-Gon's Lightsaber. Flash Of Insight unmarked, so printed.
* Original-era (V) slips: Careful Planning x2 (VS8), Sai'torr Kal Fas (VS1).

== Strategy ==

On your first turn activate 6 from your sites. then  use city outskirts and pull Qui-gon and look for his saber.Then if you force left move him to Tosche Station.So on second turn 16 force from your sites and drain for two.You will be lucky if you get Lightsaber Proficency

deplloy it on your first turn if possible you drain for three!!!Second turn.and use tunnels to get Shmi then pull threepio.If you want more force use tunnels to get Slave Quarters then

pull shmi then Threepio.If your facing Walkers

you might want to have a Corran and Mechanical   failure with controll use Mechanical failure ona weak walker and deploy Corran to the no icons site is and deploy other people BIG BEATDOWN.I want to play credits will do fine but I need Watto's Junk yard.
